traits.name: Shadow Stealth
traits.text:
When in dim light or darkness, the ghost-faced orc can
Hide as a bonus action.

traits.name: Spellcasting
traits.text: The battle priest is a 9th level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save DC 16, +8 to hit with spell attacks). It has the following cleric spells prepared: * Cantrips (at will): chill touch, guidance, mending, resistance, thaumaturgy * 1st level (4 slots): bane, command, cure wounds, inflict wounds, protection from evil and good * 2nd level (3 slots): blindness/deafness, enhance ability, hold person, silence, spiritual weapon * 3rd level (3 slots): bestow curse, dispel magic, protection from energy, spirit guardians * 4th level (3 slots): banishment, death ward * 5th level (1 slot): insect plague

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The battle priest makes two melee attacks.

actions.name: Mace
actions.text:
Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12
(2d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage.
